A rule of interpretation according to which in
 the absence of a {#Sruti#} text supporting what is stated in {#smfti#}s
 and {#kalpasUtra#}s, the existence of a general {#Sruti#} text in its
 support may be assumed on the strength of inference. It is not, however,
 admissible to assume the existence of restricted {#Sruti#} texts ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%}
 texts restricting a particular act to a particular class or land);
 {#sAmAnyaSrutikalpanAyAmasti pramARaM na viSezaSrutikalpanAyAm .#} This
 rule is discussed by {#jEmini#} and {#Sabara#} at <ls>MS. 1. 3. 15-23</ls>.
